get_epoch_lr: get the learning rate for a given epoch using the configured policy with linear warmup support
get_lr_fun: get the learning rate policy function by name from the configured OPTIM.LR_POLICY setting
lr_fun_steps: compute the learning rate using a step decay schedule based on configured step boundaries and multiplier
lr_fun_exp: compute the learning rate using an exponential decay schedule with a configurable gamma factor
lr_fun_cos: compute the learning rate using a cosine annealing schedule from base_lr down to zero over max epochs
